name: Inner Loop Optimizations for CPU Mesh Voxelization
aliases: Pre-allocated hit_xs and rolling index voxelization
definition: A set of structural and algorithmic optimizations applied to the core inner loop of `MeshProcessor::voxelize` to reduce overhead in hot loops processing millions of grid cells.
summary: Inner Loop Optimizations for CPU Mesh Voxelization reduces constant overhead by pre-allocating memory, hoisting loop-invariant calculations, and replacing binary searches with rolling indices for amortized O(1) lookups.
